aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Meesho implementation — Meesho's 0% Commission Policy (Confirmed by Data)
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS forward_expense_rows,
  SUM(net_commission) AS total_net_commission,
  SUM(commission_gst) AS total_commission_gst,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(net_commission) / NULLIF(SUM(taxable_shipping + meesho_mall_platformfee + fixed_fee), 0), 2) AS observed_commission_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.meesho_forward_expenses
WHERE CAST(is_active AS VARCHAR) = 'true';
